visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Rest of the List Is Lost
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The list 1 2 3 4 should print as 4 3 2 1 after reversing, but the program prints only 1.

solution.explanation: Saving next after head->next has been overwritten just saves prev. The pointer to the remaining nodes is gone, the loop ends after the first node, and the rest of the list is unreachable. Save the next node first, then relink.
